review.images: The Aldar factsheet supplies the main building and living room. Four FutureKey project views add the alternate exterior, squash court, wellness lounge and bathroom. Corporate image links returned HTTP 403. Other Source releases and duplicate images were excluded.
review.location: The official factsheet names the Saadiyat Grove gateway and shows the building above its plaza. Rendr gives straight-line neighbourhood distances. No surveyed entrance or reliable route times were verified.
review.floorPlans: Four publicly served Property Finder illustrations are listed as Type A for the project. The listing gives 1,184 sq ft for the one-bedroom image only. Golden Dome’s copies returned HTTP 403. FutureKey lists size averages without corresponding public drawings. No category average was applied to a plan.

unavailable: Surveyed entrances, reliable route times and exact signed areas for the 2–4 BR drawings.
